scope: Passive review and public-source verification; no active vendor probing.

decisions.decision: The contributed prefixes were reviewed against IEEE allocation snapshots. The researcher export now includes only the explicit drone, autonomous-vehicle, robot and related-equipment allowlist in integration/device-oui.json; general electronics and ambiguous corporate allocations are excluded.

Export all 3,738 reviewed scanner rules. Do not import the contributed model-aggregated minimum/maximum ranges; they can include serials that belong to different models. The 12 additional declarations remain deferred pending valid, bounded allocations.

Reconcile supported scanner windows, protocol references and documented channel tables. Separate frequency centers, band spans, occupied bandwidth and channel spacing. Do not turn a common frequency into device identity.
Use independently sourced product/API workflows. Cert-log or DNS hostnames do not prove service reachability, vulnerabilities, control paths or live device connections.
No new dated, geolocated observations established by this input review; no synthetic live or historical pins added.
Retain the eight existing published-pattern rules and 25 platform references. Broad vendor SSID prefixes, generic UUIDs and common ports in the input are insufficient for new reliable identifiers.

Preserve contributed equipment facts with explicit review status. Official Skydio e-label documentation supports seven product associations and corrects the X10 cellular ID. Direct FCC grant retrieval was blocked; other supplied dates/frequencies are not upgraded to verified.

collector_recommendations.recommendation: Store provider and timestamp per response. Merge partial fallback observations with dated prior evidence rather than interpreting a smaller list as disappeared hosts. Match exact domain or dot-boundary suffix.

Keep declaration category, acceptance status, revision and serial-file evidence. Compare full revisions; do not infer a new model from a changed file count. Preserve prior valid data when fetches are incomplete.
